source.title: Release Notes for 10/10/2014
source.quote: Introducing Music Kits, featuring new music exclusively made for CS:GO by various artists and composers.

note: Valve, CS:GO (70) is the default CS:GO music, in the game since 2012, and became selectable with the first music kits. It was also granted as a separate item on 2023-09-27 ("CS:GO Players who started playing more than a week ago will receive a commemorative CS:GO coin and CS:GO Music Kit").

source.title: Case, Capsule, Kit, Oh My!
source.quote: Finally, we’re also shipping the Denzel Curry ULTIMATE music kit, featuring Denzel’s hits “Walkin”, “ULTIMATE”, and more from his 2022 album “Melt My Eyez See Your Future”.

note: The release notes for this update do not mention the kit, so the announcement post from the same day is the source (DATA-14).
